Problem Statement:
Given a number print the sum of each digit to the power of number of digits in given input. 
Input Description:
N 
Output Description:
print the sum of the each digit to the power of number of digits:
( 1 ^ 4 ) + ( 2 ^ 4 ) + ( 3 ^ 4 ) + ( 4 ^ 4 )
=> 1 + 16 + 81 + 256
Output => 354 
Explanation:
Input => 1234
=> ( 1 ^ 4 ) + ( 2 ^ 4 ) + ( 3 ^ 4 ) + ( 4 ^ 4 )
=> 1 + 16 + 81 + 256
Output => 354 
Sample Input:
1234 
Sample Output:
354
